summary: Implemented endpoint resolution v2 builtin parameter assignment in botocore/args.py: new ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_builtins() returns AWS::Region, AWS::UseFIPS, AWS::UseDualStack, and SDK::Endpoint, and compute_client_args() exposes them under an 'endpoint_builtins' key. Added TestComputeEndpointBuiltins (7 tests) in tests/unit/test_args.py. tests/unit/test_args.py and tests/unit/test_client.py pass (297 tests). tests/unit/test_session.py::TestSessionComponent::test_internal_component fails identically on the untouched repo, so it predates this change. tests/functional fails at collection in test_waiter_config.py on the untouched repo too, so I did not run the functional suite. Scope limits: only the four core builtins are assigned; S3/STS-specific builtins are not included, and the values are not yet consumed by get_client_args or ClientCreator. Nothing is committed.
